# Devsignpro

> Freelance Full-Stack Web Developer in Morocco (Casablanca). Specializes in Next.js, Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Builds high-performance websites, e-commerce stores, and business automation dashboards that rank on Google and get cited by AI search engines.

Mohammed Elghandori (Devsignpro) helps startups and businesses ship fast, SEO-ready web products optimized for Core Web Vitals and AI discovery (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews / Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok).
